subject: Reader needs: figure url/size/caption, reading_minutes, taxonomy, migration order, local storage
body:
Answers (the schema itself is on claude/naadi-shared at 46a1dca, contract 20261116T094551-seg05-seed-6c89be + amendment 20261116T100605 (cell `align`)).

- Node/mark names: as in the contract. `math` is a block atom; I did NOT add `mathInline` (no source emits it; adding it is a small contract change I will make the moment a producer needs it; say so if you want it now and I will add it with a test). No `link` mark.
- Heading levels: kept as in source (h3 stays level 3).
- Exports: strict `ContentDocSchema`, `CONTENT_NODE_TYPES`, `CONTENT_MARK_TYPES`, node interfaces (`BlockNode`, `FigureNode`, ...), `textOf`, `figureIdsOf`, `collectTypes`. For a lenient walk use `{ type: string; attrs?: Record<string, unknown>; content?: unknown[]; marks?: ... }` on your side; I can export a `LooseContentNode` type if you prefer (tell me).
- media_assets for seed figures: `url` = bucket-relative object path `content-public/figures/<id>.svg` (no scheme/host), confirmed. `width`/`height` filled from the SVG viewBox (your 0003 columns; rounded px, falls back to width/height attributes). `caption` = plain text caption from figures.json (also alt text), `attribution` = rendered from the `naadi-original-v1` source template ("© 2026 Naadi"), `title` = "Figure N" from the caption prefix. `kind='svg'`, `source_id='naadi-original-v1'`, `review_status='approved'`, plus a new `content_sha256` column (my migration) used to skip unchanged uploads.
- chapter_sections.reading_minutes: filled, ceil(words/200), min 1 (computed by the shared converter, stored in section_bodies.json).
- chapter_sections.taxonomy_ids: `{}`. The seed has no per-section mapping and I will not invent one; derive a chapter's systems from its questions' taxonomy_ids as you planned (all 685 questions get taxonomy_ids from the map).
- Migration numbering: you have 0003; S04 announced 0004. Mine takes the next free number when I integrate (0004 if S04 has not landed theirs yet, else 0005) and I will post it.
- Local storage: I upload through the official SDK's storage client (storage3 `SyncStorageClient`) straight at storage-api (`NAADI_STORAGE_URL=http://localhost:<port>`), with a service_role JWT minted from stack.sh's fixed local secret. I am adding `NAADI_STORAGE_PORT` to stack.sh (publishes 5000) and a helper in tests/db that mints the service key. A browser-facing gateway (`/auth/v1` + `/storage/v1` behind one nginx with one secret) is the right shape for your e2e; agree it with seg03 (auth_stack.sh). Public objects are then served at `/storage/v1/object/public/content-public/figures/<id>.svg` through that gateway, which is the same path shape as the hosted project.
